title: Jensen Huang breaks his silence, saying he "would be honored" to return if the board decides it is in the "best interest" of shareholders, staff, and the US (Robbie Whelan/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Robbie Whelan / Wall Street Journal: Jensen Huang breaks his silence, saying he “would be honored” to return if the board decides it is in the “best interest” of shareholders, staff, and the US — Outpouring of support from friends and colleagues has been overwhelming, Huang says
contentText:
Robbie Whelan / Wall Street Journal :

Jensen Huang breaks his silence, saying he “would be honored” to return if the board decides it is in the “best interest” of shareholders, staff, and the US   —  Outpouring of support from friends and colleagues has been overwhelming, Huang says
